evidence.detail: No results — no Discord-role-based badge system exists in the codebase
Only badge in current system is archetypes_badge (admin-only navigation badge for edit_archetypes), not person/Discord-role badges
Badge system exists only in navigation menu, not on person profile pages
discord_id is stored on person but no role-based attributes (podcaster, streamer, etc.) are fetched or surfaced

triage.notes: Implementing this requires: (1) Discord API integration to read guild member roles for a given discord_id, (2) mapping role IDs to badge types, (3) surfacing badges on person profile pages via new template/view changes, and (4) deciding which Discord roles warrant badges — a product judgment. Scope exceeds easy-fix threshold.
